promise: US$30 billion of 'fast-start' climate finance to developing countries over the next three years (2010-2012), rising to US$100 billion per year by 2020.
description: The fast-start finance element of the Copenhagen Accord was delivered. OECD assessments counted roughly US$33 billion in fast-start finance flows over 2010-2012, slightly exceeding the pledge (the companion $100bn/yr-by-2020 pledge is tracked separately in this dataset's exclusions).
evidence: OECD 'Climate finance in 2013-14 and the USD 100 billion goal' confirmed ~$33bn fast-start finance delivered 2010-2012
Delivery exceeded the $30bn pledge even by conservative donor-accounting measures
